# Oncoplots of chromatin genes: RNA leading-edge and curated sets

This Rmd plots somatic mutations (WES) in two chromatin gene lists:

- **Leading-edge genes**: rows of the RNA-seq leading-edge heatmap (RNA-selected).
- **Curated chromatin genes**: all 241 genes of the 15 curated sets, shown as one
  combined oncoplot and one oncoplot per biological module (7 modules). This list
  is defined a priori and does not depend on the RNA clusters.

Final figures: for each gene list (leading-edge genes; all curated genes), two
SEPARATE plots with identical column order and clinical tracks:

- **Mutation oncoplot**: nonsilent mutations with PCGR VAF >= 5%.
- **CNV oncoplot**: PCGR copy-number calls (Gain / Hetdel / Homdel; most severe
  call per gene per tumor), rows = genes with a CNV in >= 1 tumor.

Rows are ordered by the number of altered tumors; columns are grouped by RNA NMF
cluster (WES-only tumors shown as "No RNA") with TP order within each group.
A merged mutation + CNV plot is optional (PLOT_COMBINED).

A gene-level audit records, for every requested gene, the first filter that
removed it (no variant, only silent, VAF not matched, VAF <5%) or that it was plotted.

Inputs and logic:

1. **Genes**: the top leading-edge genes are re-derived from
   `fgsea_leading_edge_genes_<date>.tsv` using exactly the same ranking as the
   RNA script (comparison count > cluster count > pathway count > minimum FDR).
2. **Gene eligibility**: genes must be present in the nonsilent VAF >=5% gene
   mutation-frequency table.
3. **Cells**: sample x gene mutation calls come from the MAF (the frequency table
   is gene-level and cannot define cells). The MAF has no VAF column, so VAF is
   taken from the PCGR VAF match-audit table written by the upstream
   TopGenes script (PCGR VAF_TUMOR matched by sample|gene|genomic-variant key).
   The same nonsilent classes (including Splice_Region) and VAF >=0.05 filter are
   applied, so cells reproduce the frequency table; concordance is checked.
4. **Plot style**: identical to the functional-category oncoplot script
   (Multi_Hit, PCGR oncogenicity symbols, top/right stacked barplots, bottom
   clinical tracks, TP sample order).

Interpretation: leading-edge genes were selected from RNA expression. This plot
shows whether they are also mutated; it does not show that mutations cause the
expression differences.

```{r paths_and_settings}
# ============================================================
# Paths
# ============================================================

# MAF providing sample-level mutation calls.
# IMPORTANT: this should be the MAF that generated the frequency table below.
# The concordance table written later confirms whether they agree.
maf_file <- "/ix1/alee/LO_LAB/Personal/Rahul/pILC/WES/Downstream/PCGR/Compare_TumorOnly_vs_WithPON/maftools/Tier_1_common/Combined_MAF/Tier_1_common_all_samples.combined.maf"

# Gene-level nonsilent VAF >=5% mutation-frequency table (defines eligible genes).
gene_freq_file <- "/ix1/alee/LO_LAB/Personal/Rahul/pILC/WES/Downstream/PCGR/Compare_TumorOnly_vs_WithPON/maftools/Tier_1_common/Combined_MAF/Full_MAF_nonsilent_VAFge5pct_gene_mutation_frequency_2026-09-23.tsv"

# Variant-level PCGR VAF match audit written by the SAME upstream run
# (same date as the frequency table). Provides VAF_TUMOR_fraction per MAF row.
vaf_audit_file <- "/ix1/alee/LO_LAB/Personal/Rahul/pILC/WES/Downstream/PCGR/Compare_TumorOnly_vs_WithPON/maftools/Tier_1_common/Combined_MAF/Full_MAF_nonsilent_variant_PCGR_VAF_match_audit_2026-09-23.tsv"

# Output root of the focused chromatin pathway (RNA-seq) analysis.
chromatin_out_root <- "/ix1/alee/LO_LAB/Personal/Rahul/pILC/RNASeq/Downstream/Focused_Chromatin_Pathway_Analysis"

# NA = automatically use the most recent dated run folder.
# To use a specific run, set e.g.
# CHROMATIN_RUN_DIR <- file.path(chromatin_out_root, "pILC_Focused_Chromatin_Pathway_Analysis_2026-09-24")
CHROMATIN_RUN_DIR <- NA_character_

pcgr_dir <- "/ix1/alee/LO_LAB/Personal/Rahul/pILC/WES/Downstream/PCGR/With_PON/pcgr_outputs"

clinical_file <- "/ix1/alee/LO_LAB/Personal/Rahul/pILC/Clinical_correlation/pILC_ClinicoPathological_details.csv"

# ============================================================
# Settings
# ============================================================

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Which gene lists to plot
# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Leading-edge genes: RNA-selected (rows of the leading-edge heatmap).
RUN_LEADING_EDGE <- TRUE
N_LEADING_EDGE_GENES <- 75L   # same as the RNA script

# Curated chromatin genes: all 241 genes of the 15 curated sets, independent
# of the RNA clusters. Produces one combined plot plus one plot per module.
RUN_CURATED <- TRUE

# Also make one oncoplot per curated module (7 extra plots).
# FALSE = the two final oncoplots only (leading-edge + all curated genes).
RUN_CURATED_MODULES <- FALSE

# Column order for all oncoplots:
# TRUE  = grouped by RNA NMF cluster (1, 2, 3, then WES-only "No RNA"),
#         TP order within each group, with an RNA-cluster bar on top.
# FALSE = TP order only (original style).
ORDER_BY_RNA_CLUSTER <- TRUE

# NMF cluster membership used in the RNA analysis (k = 3).
cluster_gct_file <- "/ix1/alee/LO_LAB/Personal/Rahul/pILC/RNASeq/NMF/GenePattern_NMFConsensus/vst_transformed_data.consensus.k.3.gct"

# Same cluster colors as the RNA heatmaps; grey for tumors without RNA-seq.
rna_cluster_colors <- c(
  "Cluster 1" = "#1B9E77",
  "Cluster 2" = "#D95F02",
  "Cluster 3" = "#7570B3",
  "No RNA"    = "#BDBDBD"
)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Copy-number (CNV) layer for the integrated oncoplots
# ------------------------------------------------------------
# TRUE = read the PCGR CNV files (needed for the CNV plots).
INCLUDE_CNV <- TRUE

# Which plots to make for each gene list (separate figures, not merged):
PLOT_MUTATION <- TRUE    # mutation oncoplot  (nonsilent, PCGR VAF >= 5%)
PLOT_CNV      <- TRUE    # CNV oncoplot       (PCGR Gain / Hetdel / Homdel)
PLOT_COMBINED <- FALSE   # optional merged mutation + CNV plot (off by default)

# Per-sample PCGR CNV CSV files (same folder and pattern as CNV_Plot_WES.Rmd).
CNV_DIR <- "/ix1/alee/LO_LAB/Personal/Rahul/pILC/WES/Downstream/PCGR/CNV_PCGR/Plot"
CNV_FILE_PATTERN <- "^TP.*_T\\.csv$"

# A gene is shown if it has a qualifying mutation OR a CNV in >= this many tumors.
MIN_CNV_SAMPLES <- 1L

# CNV colors (same as CNV_Plot_WES.Rmd).
cnv_cols <- c(
  "Gain"   = "#31A354",  # green
  "Hetdel" = "#8C6D31",  # brown
  "Homdel" = "#D7301F"   # red
)

# Size of the mutation box inside a cell when CNV is shown (fraction of the cell).
mut_inner_frac <- 0.58

# Flag MAF symbols that are older aliases of a gene in the lists
# (requires AnnotationDbi + org.Hs.eg.db).
CHECK_SYMBOL_ALIASES <- TRUE

# Same VAF threshold and nonsilent classes as the upstream TopGenes script,
# so the oncoplot cells reproduce the frequency table exactly.
MIN_VAF <- 0.05
MIN_VAF_PERCENT <- 100 * MIN_VAF

nonsilent_classes <- c(
  "Missense_Mutation",
  "Nonsense_Mutation",
  "Nonstop_Mutation",
  "Frame_Shift_Del",
  "Frame_Shift_Ins",
  "In_Frame_Del",
  "In_Frame_Ins",
  "Splice_Site",
  "Splice_Region",
  "Translation_Start_Site"
)
VAF_TAG <- paste0("VAFge", MIN_VAF_PERCENT, "pct")
VAF_LABEL <- paste0("VAF \u2265", MIN_VAF_PERCENT, "%")

out_dir <- file.path(
  "/ix1/alee/LO_LAB/Personal/Rahul/pILC/WES/Downstream/PCGR/Compare_TumorOnly_vs_WithPON/maftools/Tier_1_common/plots/Chromatin_gene_oncoplots",
  VAF_TAG
)
table_dir <- file.path(out_dir, "tables")

dir.create(out_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
dir.create(table_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

# If TRUE, unmatched variants can still receive cell-level annotation
# using Sample + Gene from PCGR (useful for splice-site rows without HGVSp).
allow_sample_gene_fallback <- TRUE

# PNG rendering can be slow for ComplexHeatmap.
SAVE_PNG <- TRUE

# Stop early if an input is missing.
input_files <- c(
  maf_file = maf_file,
  gene_freq_file = gene_freq_file,
  vaf_audit_file = vaf_audit_file,
  clinical_file = clinical_file
)
missing_inputs <- names(input_files)[!file.exists(input_files)]
if (length(missing_inputs) > 0) {
  stop("Input file(s) not found:\n",
       paste0(missing_inputs, ": ", input_files[missing_inputs], collapse = "\n"))
}
```

```{r colors}
# ============================================================
# Colors (identical to the functional-category oncoplot script)
# ============================================================

grade_cols <- c(
  "Grade I" = "#A6CEE3",
  "Grade II" = "#33A02C",
  "Grade III" = "#1F78B4",
  "Cell type not determined" = "#E31A1C",
  "Unknown" = "#BDBDBD"
)

binary_receptor_cols <- c(
  "Negative" = "#1F78B4",
  "Positive" = "#E31A1C",
  "Unknown"  = "#BDBDBD"
)

base_mutation_colors <- c(
  "Missense_Mutation"       = "#1F77B4",
  "Nonsense_Mutation"       = "#D62728",
  "Frame_Shift_Del"         = "#9467BD",
  "Frame_Shift_Ins"         = "#8C564B",
  "In_Frame_Del"            = "#2CA02C",
  "In_Frame_Ins"            = "#17BECF",
  "Splice_Site"             = "#FF7F0E",
  "Splice_Region"           = "#FFBB78",   # counted as nonsilent upstream
  "Translation_Start_Site"  = "#E377C2",
  "Nonstop_Mutation"        = "#BCBD22",
  "Multi_Hit"               = "#000000"
)

get_mutation_colors <- function(types) {
  types <- unique(types)
  types <- types[!is.na(types) & types != ""]

  known <- intersect(types, names(base_mutation_colors))
  missing <- setdiff(types, names(base_mutation_colors))

  cols <- base_mutation_colors[known]

  if (length(missing) > 0) {
    extra_cols <- hcl.colors(length(missing), palette = "Dark 3")
    names(extra_cols) <- missing
    cols <- c(cols, extra_cols)
  }

  cols[types]
}
```

```{r helper_functions}
# ============================================================
# Helper functions (same as the functional-category script,
# plus a VAF helper)
# ============================================================

clean_key <- function(x) {
  x <- as.character(x)
  x <- trimws(x)
  x[x %in% c("", ".", "NA", "N/A", "nan", "NaN")] <- NA_character_
  toupper(x)
}

clean_sample <- function(x) {
  x <- as.character(x)
  x <- trimws(x)

  # Clinical file has TP03-117; MAF/PCGR may have TP03-117_T
  x <- sub("_T$", "", x)
  x <- sub("-T$", "", x)
  x <- sub("\\.T$", "", x)

  toupper(x)
}

natural_sample_order <- function(samples) {
  samples <- unique(as.character(samples))

  sample_clean <- sub("_T$", "", samples)
  tp_num <- suppressWarnings(as.integer(sub("^TP([0-9]+).*", "\\1", sample_clean)))
  tp_num[is.na(tp_num)] <- 9999L

  rest <- sub("^TP[0-9]+[-_]*", "", sample_clean)

  samples[order(tp_num, rest, samples)]
}

clean_hgv <- function(x) {
  x <- as.character(x)
  x <- trimws(x)
  x[x %in% c("", ".", "NA", "N/A", "nan", "NaN")] <- NA_character_
  x <- sub(".*:", "", x)
  toupper(x)
}

normalize_oncogenicity <- function(x) {
  x <- as.character(x)
  x <- trimws(x)
  x <- gsub("[ -]+", "_", x)
  x <- toupper(x)

  out <- rep(NA_character_, length(x))
  out[x == "ONCOGENIC"] <- "Oncogenic"
  out[x == "LIKELY_ONCOGENIC"] <- "Likely_Oncogenic"

  out
}

normalize_colname <- function(x) {
  toupper(gsub("[^A-Za-z0-9]", "", x))
}

find_col <- function(cols, candidates) {
  ncols <- normalize_colname(cols)
  ncand <- normalize_colname(candidates)

  hit <- match(ncand, ncols)
  hit <- hit[!is.na(hit)]

  if (length(hit) > 0) {
    return(cols[hit[1]])
  } else {
    return(NA_character_)
  }
}

get_col_or_na <- function(dt, candidates) {
  col <- find_col(colnames(dt), candidates)

  if (is.na(col)) {
    return(rep(NA_character_, nrow(dt)))
  } else {
    return(as.character(dt[[col]]))
  }
}

safe_file_name <- function(x) {
  x <- gsub("[^A-Za-z0-9]+", "_", x)
  x <- gsub("_+", "_", x)
  x <- gsub("^_|_$", "", x)
  x
}

parse_percent_value <- function(x) {
  x <- as.character(x)
  x <- trimws(x)

  x[x %in% c("", "NA", "N/A", "NaN", "nan")] <- NA_character_

  is_less_than <- grepl("^<", x)

  val <- suppressWarnings(
    as.numeric(gsub("[^0-9.]", "", x))
  )

  val[is_less_than & !is.na(val)] <- val[is_less_than & !is.na(val)] / 2

  return(val)
}

clean_receptor_status <- function(x) {
  x <- as.character(x)
  x <- trimws(x)
  x <- gsub("\\s+", " ", x)

  out <- rep("Unknown", length(x))

  out[grepl("^Positive", x, ignore.case = TRUE)] <- "Positive"
  out[grepl("^Negative", x, ignore.case = TRUE)] <- "Negative"

  out[x %in% c("", "NA", "N/A", "NaN", "nan") | is.na(x)] <- "Unknown"

  return(out)
}

clean_grade_status <- function(x) {
  x <- as.character(x)
  x <- trimws(x)
  x <- gsub("\\s+", " ", x)

  out <- x
  out[x %in% c("", "NA", "N/A", "NaN", "nan") | is.na(x)] <- "Unknown"

  return(out)
}

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Variant-key helpers COPIED UNCHANGED from the upstream TopGenes script.
# They must stay identical so Match_key agrees with the VAF audit table.
# (Separate names avoid clashing with clean_sample() used for clinical matching.)
# ------------------------------------------------------------

vaf_clean_sample <- function(x) {
  x <- toupper(trimws(as.character(x)))
  x <- sub("(_T|-T|\\.T)$", "", x)
  x[x %in% c("", ".", "NA", "N/A")] <- NA_character_
  x
}

vaf_clean_gene <- function(x) {
  x <- toupper(trimws(as.character(x)))
  x[x %in% c("", ".", "NA", "N/A")] <- NA_character_
  x
}

# Consistent genomic-allele key. MAF insertions with REF="-" use the left-flank
# coordinate, so the inserted sequence begins at Start_Position + 1.
edit_key <- function(chr, pos, ref, alt, maf_format = FALSE) {
  chr <- sub("^CHR", "", toupper(trimws(as.character(chr))))
  pos <- suppressWarnings(as.integer(pos))
  ref <- toupper(trimws(as.character(ref)))
  alt <- toupper(trimws(as.character(alt)))

  if (anyNA(c(chr, pos, ref, alt)) ||
      !nzchar(chr) || pos < 1L ||
      !grepl("^([ACGTN]+|-)$", ref) ||
      !grepl("^([ACGTN]+|-)$", alt)) {
    return(NA_character_)
  }

  if (maf_format && ref == "-") {
    pos <- pos + 1L
  }

  if (ref == "-") ref <- ""
  if (alt == "-") alt <- ""

  # Remove identical suffixes.
  while (nzchar(ref) && nzchar(alt) &&
         substr(ref, nchar(ref), nchar(ref)) ==
           substr(alt, nchar(alt), nchar(alt))) {
    ref <- substr(ref, 1, nchar(ref) - 1L)
    alt <- substr(alt, 1, nchar(alt) - 1L)
  }

  # Remove identical prefixes and shift the position.
  while (nzchar(ref) && nzchar(alt) &&
         substr(ref, 1, 1) == substr(alt, 1, 1)) {
    ref <- substring(ref, 2)
    alt <- substring(alt, 2)
    pos <- pos + 1L
  }

  if (!nzchar(ref) && !nzchar(alt)) {
    return(NA_character_)
  }

  paste(
    chr,
    pos,
    ifelse(nzchar(ref), ref, "-"),
    ifelse(nzchar(alt), alt, "-"),
    sep = ":"
  )
}
```

```{r leading_edge_genes}
# ============================================================
# Gene list 1: genes shown in the RNA leading-edge heatmap
# ============================================================

heatmap_genes <- character()
leading_edge_file <- NA_character_

if (isTRUE(RUN_LEADING_EDGE)) {

  # Locate the chromatin analysis run folder.
  if (is.na(CHROMATIN_RUN_DIR)) {
    run_dirs <- list.dirs(chromatin_out_root, recursive = FALSE, full.names = TRUE)
    run_dirs <- run_dirs[grepl(
      "pILC_Focused_Chromatin_Pathway_Analysis_[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}$", run_dirs
    )]
    if (length(run_dirs) == 0) stop("No chromatin analysis run folder found in: ", chromatin_out_root)
    CHROMATIN_RUN_DIR <- sort(run_dirs, decreasing = TRUE)[1]
  }

  leading_edge_files <- list.files(
    file.path(CHROMATIN_RUN_DIR, "tables"),
    pattern = "^fgsea_leading_edge_genes_.*\\.tsv$",
    full.names = TRUE
  )
  if (length(leading_edge_files) != 1) {
    stop("Expected one fgsea_leading_edge_genes_*.tsv in ", CHROMATIN_RUN_DIR,
         "/tables; found ", length(leading_edge_files))
  }
  leading_edge_file <- leading_edge_files[1]
  cat("Leading-edge table:\n", leading_edge_file, "\n\n")

  leading_edge_long <- fread(leading_edge_file, sep = "\t", data.table = TRUE)

  required_le_cols <- c("Gene", "Pathway", "Target_cluster", "Comparison", "FDR")
  missing_le_cols <- setdiff(required_le_cols, colnames(leading_edge_long))
  if (length(missing_le_cols) > 0) {
    stop("Leading-edge table is missing column(s): ", paste(missing_le_cols, collapse = ", "))
  }

  # Same ranking as the RNA script: genes recurring across more comparisons,
  # clusters and pathways first, then by the smallest FDR.
  leading_rank <- leading_edge_long[
    ,
    .(
      Pathway_count = uniqueN(Pathway),
      Cluster_count = uniqueN(Target_cluster),
      Comparison_count = uniqueN(Comparison),
      Minimum_FDR = min(FDR, na.rm = TRUE)
    ),
    by = Gene
  ]
  setorder(leading_rank, -Comparison_count, -Cluster_count, -Pathway_count, Minimum_FDR)

  heatmap_genes <- head(leading_rank$Gene, N_LEADING_EDGE_GENES)
  cat("Leading-edge genes shown in the RNA heatmap:", length(heatmap_genes), "\n\n")
}
```

```{r curated_gene_sets}
  NUCLEOSOME_ASSEMBLY_CHAPERONES = c(
    "HIRA", "ASF1A", "ASF1B", "CHAF1A", "CHAF1B", "NASP", "NAP1L1",
    "NAP1L4", "DAXX", "ATRX", "HJURP", "ANP32E", "DEK", "SUPT16H",
    "SSRP1"
  ),
  CHROMATIN_REMODELING_EXPANDED = c(
    "ARID1A", "ARID1B", "ARID2", "SMARCA2", "SMARCA4", "SMARCB1",
    "SMARCC1", "SMARCC2", "PBRM1", "CHD1", "CHD2", "CHD3", "CHD4",
    "CHD5", "CHD6", "CHD7", "CHD8", "CHD9", "ATRX", "DAXX", "SRCAP",
    "EP400", "INO80", "INO80B", "INO80C", "INO80D", "INO80E", "HELLS"
  )
)

# The 7 biological modules used on the summary slide.
curated_modules <- list(
  Chromatin_remodeling = c("SWI_SNF_BAF_CORE", "CHROMATIN_REMODELING_EXPANDED",
                           "NUCLEOSOME_ASSEMBLY_CHAPERONES"),
  Polycomb_repression = c("PRC2_CORE", "PRC1_CORE"),
  Histone_acetylation = c("HISTONE_ACETYLTRANSFERASE_HAT_PROGRAM", "HDAC_PROGRAM"),
  Histone_methylation = c("HISTONE_LYSINE_METHYLTRANSFERASES", "HISTONE_LYSINE_DEMETHYLASES"),
  Histone_ubiquitination = c("HISTONE_UBIQUITINATION_MACHINERY",
                             "HISTONE_DEUBIQUITINATION_MACHINERY"),
  DNA_methylation = c("DNA_METHYLATION_WRITERS_READERS", "DNA_DEMETHYLATION_PROGRAM"),
  Heterochromatin_DNA_damage_marks = c("HETEROCHROMATIN_FORMATION",
                                       "HISTONE_PHOSPHORYLATION_DNA_DAMAGE")
)
stopifnot(setequal(unlist(curated_modules), names(curated_sets)))

curated_module_genes <- lapply(curated_modules, function(set_names) {
  unique(unlist(curated_sets[set_names], use.names = FALSE))
})
curated_all_genes <- unique(unlist(curated_sets, use.names = FALSE))
cat("Curated chromatin genes (unique):", length(curated_all_genes), "\n\n")

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Named list of gene lists; each becomes one oncoplot.
# A gene can appear in more than one module plot.
# ------------------------------------------------------------
oncoplot_sets <- list()
if (isTRUE(RUN_LEADING_EDGE) && length(heatmap_genes) > 0) {
  oncoplot_sets[["Chromatin_leading_edge_genes"]] <- heatmap_genes
}
if (isTRUE(RUN_CURATED)) {
  # Oncoplot 2: all curated chromatin genes in one plot
  oncoplot_sets[["Curated_chromatin_all_genes"]] <- curated_all_genes

  # Optional: one plot per module
  if (isTRUE(RUN_CURATED_MODULES)) {
    for (m in names(curated_module_genes)) {
      oncoplot_sets[[paste0("Curated_", m)]] <- curated_module_genes[[m]]
    }
  }
}
if (length(oncoplot_sets) == 0) stop("No gene lists selected (RUN_LEADING_EDGE / RUN_CURATED).")
print(data.table(Gene_list = names(oncoplot_sets), Genes = lengths(oncoplot_sets)))
```

```{r read_clinical}
# ============================================================
# Read clinical file (same as the functional-category script)

cat("Reading clinical annotation file:\n", clinical_file, "\n\n")
```

```{r read_maf_and_frequency}
# ============================================================
# Read the MAF exactly as the upstream TopGenes script does (fread),
# attach PCGR VAF from the match-audit table, and apply the same filter.
# read.maf() is NOT used: it moves Splice_Region rows out of @data,
# while the upstream frequency table counts Splice_Region as nonsilent.
# ============================================================

cat("Reading MAF:\n", maf_file, "\n\n")

maf_full <- fread(
  maf_file,
  sep = "\t",
  header = TRUE,
  data.table = TRUE,
  na.strings = c("", ".", "NA", "N/A")
)

required_maf_cols <- c(
  "Hugo_Symbol", "Tumor_Sample_Barcode", "Variant_Classification",
  "Chromosome", "Start_Position", "Reference_Allele", "Tumor_Seq_Allele2"
)
missing_required <- setdiff(required_maf_cols, colnames(maf_full))
if (length(missing_required) > 0) {
  stop("Missing required MAF columns: ", paste(missing_required, collapse = ", "))
}

# Cohort = every sample in the full MAF (same denominator as the upstream
# frequency table). TP order as in the original oncoplot script.
all_samples <- natural_sample_order(unique(as.character(maf_full$Tumor_Sample_Barcode)))
cat("Cohort samples:", length(all_samples), "\n")

# Rebuild the upstream sample|gene|variant key for every MAF row.
maf_full[, Variant_key := mapply(
  edit_key,
  Chromosome, Start_Position, Reference_Allele, Tumor_Seq_Allele2,
  MoreArgs = list(maf_format = TRUE),
  USE.NAMES = FALSE
)]
maf_full[, Match_key := paste(
  vaf_clean_sample(Tumor_Sample_Barcode),
  vaf_clean_gene(Hugo_Symbol),
  Variant_key,
  sep = "|"
)]

# VAF per key from the upstream audit (one value per key).
vaf_audit <- fread(vaf_audit_file, sep = "\t", header = TRUE, data.table = TRUE)
if (!all(c("Match_key", "VAF_TUMOR_fraction") %in% colnames(vaf_audit))) {
  stop("VAF audit file must contain Match_key and VAF_TUMOR_fraction columns.")
}
vaf_by_key <- unique(
  vaf_audit[, .(Match_key, VAF_TUMOR_fraction = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(VAF_TUMOR_fraction)))],
  by = "Match_key"
)

maf_full <- merge(maf_full, vaf_by_key, by = "Match_key", all.x = TRUE, sort = FALSE)

# Same retention rule as upstream: nonsilent class + gene present + VAF >= 0.05.
# Rows without a matched PCGR VAF are excluded, as upstream.
maf_dt <- maf_full[
  Variant_Classification %in% nonsilent_classes &
    !is.na(vaf_clean_gene(Hugo_Symbol)) &
    !is.na(VAF_TUMOR_fraction) &
    VAF_TUMOR_fraction >= MIN_VAF
]
maf_dt[, Variant_Classification := as.character(Variant_Classification)]
maf_dt[, VAF_percent := round(100 * VAF_TUMOR_fraction, 2)]

cat("Full MAF rows:", nrow(maf_full), "\n")
cat("Rows without matched PCGR VAF:", sum(is.na(maf_full$VAF_TUMOR_fraction)), "\n")
cat("Nonsilent rows retained at ", VAF_LABEL, ": ", nrow(maf_dt), "\n\n", sep = "")

maf_dt[, maf_row_id := .I]
maf_dt[, Sample_key := clean_sample(Tumor_Sample_Barcode)]
maf_dt[, Gene_key := clean_key(Hugo_Symbol)]

if (!"HGVSp" %in% colnames(maf_dt)) maf_dt[, HGVSp := NA_character_]
if (!"HGVSp_Short" %in% colnames(maf_dt)) maf_dt[, HGVSp_Short := NA_character_]
if (!"HGVSc" %in% colnames(maf_dt)) maf_dt[, HGVSc := NA_character_]

maf_dt[, HGVSp_key := clean_hgv(HGVSp)]
maf_dt[, HGVSp_Short_key := clean_hgv(HGVSp_Short)]
maf_dt[, HGVSc_key := clean_hgv(HGVSc)]

# ============================================================
# Gene-level frequency table: defines eligible genes
# ============================================================

freq_dt <- fread(gene_freq_file, sep = "\t", header = TRUE, data.table = TRUE)

freq_gene_col <- find_col(colnames(freq_dt), c("Hugo_Symbol", "Gene", "Gene_Symbol", "SYMBOL"))
if (is.na(freq_gene_col)) {
  stop("Frequency table needs a gene column (Hugo_Symbol / Gene). Columns found: ",
       paste(colnames(freq_dt), collapse = ", "))
}

# Optional: number of mutated samples, used for the concordance check.
freq_count_col <- find_col(colnames(freq_dt), c(
  "Mutated_samples", "N_mutated_samples", "n_mutated_samples", "Samples_mutated",
  "MutatedSamples", "Altered_samples", "AlteredSamples", "N_samples", "n_samples"
))

freq_dt[, Gene_key := clean_key(get(freq_gene_col))]
freq_genes <- unique(na.omit(freq_dt$Gene_key))
cat("Genes in frequency table:", length(freq_genes), "\n")
cat("Mutated-sample count column: ",
    ifelse(is.na(freq_count_col), "not found (concordance check skipped)", freq_count_col),
    "\n\n", sep = "")

# ============================================================
# Gene audit across ALL requested genes: where each gene drops out
# ============================================================

# One row per gene, with the lists it belongs to.
gene_membership <- rbindlist(lapply(names(oncoplot_sets), function(nm) {
  data.table(Gene = oncoplot_sets[[nm]], Gene_list = nm)
}))
gene_membership[, Gene_key := clean_key(Gene)]
gene_audit <- gene_membership[
  , .(Gene = Gene[1], Gene_lists = paste(unique(Gene_list), collapse = ";")),
  by = Gene_key
]
if (length(heatmap_genes) > 0) {
  gene_audit[, Leading_edge_rank := match(Gene_key, clean_key(heatmap_genes))]
}

# Variant counts at each filter stage (full MAF, before any filtering).
maf_full[, Gene_key := vaf_clean_gene(Hugo_Symbol)]
maf_full[, Is_nonsilent := Variant_Classification %in% nonsilent_classes]
maf_full[, Passes_VAF := !is.na(VAF_TUMOR_fraction) & VAF_TUMOR_fraction >= MIN_VAF]

stage_counts <- maf_full[
  Gene_key %in% gene_audit$Gene_key,
  .(
    All_variants          = .N,
    Nonsilent             = sum(Is_nonsilent),
    Nonsilent_VAF_missing = sum(Is_nonsilent & is.na(VAF_TUMOR_fraction)),
    Nonsilent_VAF_lt5     = sum(Is_nonsilent & !is.na(VAF_TUMOR_fraction) & VAF_TUMOR_fraction < MIN_VAF),
    Nonsilent_VAF_ge5     = sum(Is_nonsilent & Passes_VAF),
    MAF_mutated_samples   = uniqueN(Tumor_Sample_Barcode[Is_nonsilent & Passes_VAF])
  ),
  by = Gene_key
]
gene_audit <- merge(gene_audit, stage_counts, by = "Gene_key", all.x = TRUE, sort = FALSE)
count_cols <- c("All_variants", "Nonsilent", "Nonsilent_VAF_missing",
                "Nonsilent_VAF_lt5", "Nonsilent_VAF_ge5", "MAF_mutated_samples")
for (cc in count_cols) gene_audit[is.na(get(cc)), (cc) := 0L]

# Frequency-table membership and count concordance.
gene_audit[, In_frequency_table := Gene_key %in% freq_genes]
if (!is.na(freq_count_col)) {
  freq_counts <- freq_dt[, .(Freq_table_mutated_samples = suppressWarnings(
    as.numeric(get(freq_count_col))[1])), by = Gene_key]
  gene_audit <- merge(gene_audit, freq_counts, by = "Gene_key", all.x = TRUE, sort = FALSE)
  gene_audit[, Counts_agree := fifelse(
    In_frequency_table,
    MAF_mutated_samples == Freq_table_mutated_samples,
    MAF_mutated_samples == 0
  )]
}

# First filter that removed each gene.
gene_audit[, Drop_reason := fcase(
  All_variants == 0,       "1_No_variant_in_MAF",
  Nonsilent == 0,          "2_Only_silent_variants",
  Nonsilent_VAF_ge5 > 0,   "Plotted",
  Nonsilent_VAF_lt5 == 0,  "3_Nonsilent_VAF_not_matched",
  default =                "4_Nonsilent_VAF_lt5pct"
)]

# Symbol check: is a "no variant" gene present in the MAF under an older alias?
gene_audit[, Possible_MAF_alias := NA_character_]
if (isTRUE(CHECK_SYMBOL_ALIASES) &&
    requireNamespace("AnnotationDbi", quietly = TRUE) &&
    requireNamespace("org.Hs.eg.db", quietly = TRUE)) {

  alias_map <- suppressMessages(tryCatch(
    AnnotationDbi::select(
      org.Hs.eg.db::org.Hs.eg.db,
      keys = unique(na.omit(maf_full$Gene_key)),
      keytype = "ALIAS",
      columns = "SYMBOL"
    ),
    error = function(e) NULL
  ))

  if (!is.null(alias_map)) {
    alias_map <- as.data.table(alias_map)[!is.na(SYMBOL)]
    alias_map[, `:=`(ALIAS = toupper(ALIAS), SYMBOL = toupper(SYMBOL))]
    alias_hits <- alias_map[
      ALIAS != SYMBOL & SYMBOL %in% gene_audit[Drop_reason == "1_No_variant_in_MAF", Gene_key],
      .(Possible_MAF_alias = paste(unique(ALIAS), collapse = ";")),
      by = .(Gene_key = SYMBOL)
    ]
    gene_audit[alias_hits, on = "Gene_key", Possible_MAF_alias := i.Possible_MAF_alias]
  }
} else if (isTRUE(CHECK_SYMBOL_ALIASES)) {
  message("AnnotationDbi/org.Hs.eg.db not available; symbol-alias check skipped.")
}

gene_audit[, Plotted := In_frequency_table & MAF_mutated_samples > 0]
setorder(gene_audit, -Plotted, -MAF_mutated_samples, Gene)

fwrite(
  gene_audit,
  file.path(table_dir, paste0("chromatin_gene_mutation_audit_", VAF_TAG, ".tsv")),
  sep = "\t", quote = FALSE, na = ""
)

# Per-list summary: how many genes survive each stage.
list_summary <- rbindlist(lapply(names(oncoplot_sets), function(nm) {
  a <- gene_audit[Gene_key %in% clean_key(oncoplot_sets[[nm]])]
  data.table(
    Gene_list = nm,
    Genes_requested = nrow(a),
    No_variant_in_MAF = sum(a$Drop_reason == "1_No_variant_in_MAF"),
    Only_silent = sum(a$Drop_reason == "2_Only_silent_variants"),
    Nonsilent_VAF_not_matched = sum(a$Drop_reason == "3_Nonsilent_VAF_not_matched"),
    Nonsilent_VAF_lt5pct = sum(a$Drop_reason == "4_Nonsilent_VAF_lt5pct"),
    Plotted = sum(a$Plotted),
    Possible_alias_flags = sum(!is.na(a$Possible_MAF_alias))
  )
}))
fwrite(
  list_summary,
  file.path(table_dir, paste0("chromatin_gene_list_filter_summary_", VAF_TAG, ".tsv")),
  sep = "\t", quote = FALSE, na = ""
)
print(list_summary)

if ("Counts_agree" %in% colnames(gene_audit)) {
  n_disagree <- gene_audit[Counts_agree == FALSE, .N]
  cat("\nGenes where MAF and frequency-table counts disagree:", n_disagree, "\n")
  if (n_disagree > 0) {
    warning("MAF and frequency table disagree for ", n_disagree,
            " gene(s); check that the MAF, VAF audit and frequency table come from the same run.")
  }
}
if (any(!is.na(gene_audit$Possible_MAF_alias))) {
  warning("Some genes may be present in the MAF under an older symbol; see Possible_MAF_alias.")
}
cat("\n")

# Genes passed to the plotting function, per list (original order kept).
plot_gene_keys <- gene_audit[Plotted == TRUE, Gene_key]
plot_sets <- lapply(oncoplot_sets, function(g) g[clean_key(g) %in% plot_gene_keys])

# Separate row sets for the separate plots (CNV sets are filled in read_cnv).
plot_sets_mutation <- plot_sets
plot_sets_cnv      <- lapply(oncoplot_sets, function(g) character())
plot_sets_combined <- plot_sets

# Clinical match check (same as the original script).
cat("Clinical samples matching MAF samples:",
    sum(clean_sample(all_samples) %in% clinical_plot_dt$Sample_key), "of",
    length(all_samples), "\n\n")
```

```{r rna_cluster_sample_order}
# ============================================================
# Sample (column) order: by RNA NMF cluster, then TP order
# ============================================================

# Join key between WES barcodes and RNA sample names:
# upper case, drop GenePattern "_S#" and tumor "_T"/"-T"/".T" suffixes,
# then remove separators so "TP03-117", "TP03.117" and "TP03_117_T" match.
sample_match_key <- function(x) {
  x <- toupper(trimws(as.character(x)))
  x <- sub("_S[0-9]+$", "", x)
  x <- sub("[-_.]T$", "", x)
  gsub("[^A-Z0-9]", "", x)
}

plot_sample_order <- all_samples   # default: TP order
plot_sample_group <- NULL          # NULL = no cluster bar / no column split

if (isTRUE(ORDER_BY_RNA_CLUSTER)) {

  if (!file.exists(cluster_gct_file)) stop("Cluster GCT not found: ", cluster_gct_file)

  cluster_raw <- fread(cluster_gct_file, skip = 2, data.table = TRUE)
  membership_col <- grep("^membership", names(cluster_raw), value = TRUE)
  if (!"Name" %in% names(cluster_raw) || length(membership_col) != 1) {
    stop("Cluster GCT must contain Name and exactly one membership column.")
  }

  rna_clusters <- cluster_raw[, .(
    RNA_sample = as.character(Name),
    Cluster_number = as.integer(get(membership_col))
  )]
  rna_clusters[, Sample_match_key := sample_match_key(RNA_sample)]
  if (anyDuplicated(rna_clusters$Sample_match_key)) {
    stop("Two RNA samples share the same match key; check RNA sample IDs.")
  }

  # One row per WES sample, in TP order.
  wes_order_dt <- data.table(
    Tumor_Sample_Barcode = all_samples,
    Sample_match_key = sample_match_key(all_samples),
    TP_order = seq_along(all_samples)
  )
  if (anyDuplicated(wes_order_dt$Sample_match_key)) {
    stop("Two WES samples share the same match key; check Tumor_Sample_Barcode IDs.")
  }

  wes_order_dt <- merge(wes_order_dt, rna_clusters, by = "Sample_match_key",
                        all.x = TRUE, sort = FALSE)
  wes_order_dt[, RNA_cluster := fifelse(
    is.na(Cluster_number), "No RNA", paste0("Cluster ", Cluster_number)
  )]
  wes_order_dt[, RNA_cluster := factor(RNA_cluster, levels = names(rna_cluster_colors))]
  if (anyNA(wes_order_dt$RNA_cluster)) stop("Unexpected cluster number in GCT.")

  # Cluster 1 -> 2 -> 3 -> No RNA; TP order within each group.
  setorder(wes_order_dt, RNA_cluster, TP_order)
  wes_order_dt[, Column_order := seq_len(.N)]

  plot_sample_order <- wes_order_dt$Tumor_Sample_Barcode
  plot_sample_group <- as.character(wes_order_dt$RNA_cluster)

  # RNA samples without WES (not shown in the oncoplots).
  rna_without_wes <- setdiff(rna_clusters$Sample_match_key, wes_order_dt$Sample_match_key)

  cat("WES samples per RNA group:\n")
  print(wes_order_dt[, .N, by = RNA_cluster])
  cat("RNA samples without WES (not in oncoplots):", length(rna_without_wes), "\n")
  if (length(rna_without_wes) > 0) {
    print(rna_clusters[Sample_match_key %in% rna_without_wes, .(RNA_sample, Cluster_number)])
  }
  cat("\n")

  fwrite(
    wes_order_dt[, .(Column_order, Tumor_Sample_Barcode, RNA_sample, RNA_cluster, TP_order)],
    file.path(table_dir, "WES_sample_RNA_cluster_order.tsv"),
    sep = "\t", quote = FALSE, na = ""
  )
}
```

```{r read_cnv}
# ============================================================
# Copy-number calls (PCGR CNV), one call per gene per sample
# ============================================================
# Logic reused from CNV_Plot_WES.Rmd:
#   - read the per-sample PCGR CNV CSV files
#   - normalize VARIANT_CLASS to Gain / Hetdel / Homdel
#   - keep the most severe call per sample x gene: Homdel > Hetdel > Gain
# The cohort for CNV = all sample files found (a tumor with no CNV calls still
# counts as assessed). CNV samples are matched to WES barcodes with the same
# key used for the RNA clusters.

# Empty template so the plotting function works when INCLUDE_CNV = FALSE.
cnv_onecall <- data.table(
  Tumor_Sample_Barcode = character(),
  Gene_key = character(),
  CNV_class = character()
)

if (isTRUE(INCLUDE_CNV)) {

  cnv_files <- sort(list.files(CNV_DIR, pattern = CNV_FILE_PATTERN, full.names = TRUE))
  if (length(cnv_files) == 0) stop("No per-sample CNV CSV files found in: ", CNV_DIR)
  cat("CNV sample files found:", length(cnv_files), "\n")

  # Same class mapping as CNV_Plot_WES.Rmd.
  normalize_cnv_class <- function(x) {
    x <- tolower(trimws(as.character(x)))
    fcase(
      x %in% c("hetdel", "het_del", "hetd", "heterozygous deletion", "het deletion"), "Hetdel",
      x %in% c("homdel", "hom_del", "homd", "homozygous deletion", "hom deletion"), "Homdel",
      x %in% c("gain", "amp", "amplification", "hlamp", "high-level amplification"), "Gain",
      default = NA_character_
    )
  }
  cnv_priority <- c(Homdel = 3L, Hetdel = 2L, Gain = 1L)

  # Read one file; the first unnamed row-name column (if any) is ignored.
  read_one_cnv <- function(f) {
    dt <- fread(f, na.strings = c("", "NA"), data.table = TRUE)
    if (!all(c("SYMBOL", "VARIANT_CLASS") %in% names(dt))) {
      stop("Missing SYMBOL or VARIANT_CLASS in ", basename(f))
    }
    data.table(
      CNV_sample = sub("\\.csv$", "", basename(f)),
      SYMBOL = as.character(dt$SYMBOL),
      VARIANT_CLASS = as.character(dt$VARIANT_CLASS)
    )
  }

  cnv_long <- rbindlist(lapply(cnv_files, read_one_cnv), use.names = TRUE)
  cnv_long[, Gene_key := clean_key(SYMBOL)]
  cnv_long[, CNV_class := normalize_cnv_class(VARIANT_CLASS)]
  cnv_long <- cnv_long[!is.na(Gene_key) & !is.na(CNV_class)]
  cnv_long[, CNV_score := cnv_priority[CNV_class]]

  # One call per sample x gene: most severe first.
  setorder(cnv_long, CNV_sample, Gene_key, -CNV_score)
  cnv_sample_gene <- unique(cnv_long, by = c("CNV_sample", "Gene_key"))

  # Match CNV samples to WES barcodes.
  cnv_sample_map <- data.table(
    CNV_sample = sub("\\.csv$", "", basename(cnv_files)),
    Sample_match_key = sample_match_key(sub("\\.csv$", "", basename(cnv_files)))
  )
  wes_key_dt <- data.table(
    Tumor_Sample_Barcode = all_samples,
    Sample_match_key = sample_match_key(all_samples)
  )
  cnv_sample_map <- merge(cnv_sample_map, wes_key_dt, by = "Sample_match_key", all = TRUE)
  cnv_sample_map[, Status := fcase(
    !is.na(CNV_sample) & !is.na(Tumor_Sample_Barcode), "CNV_and_WES_mutations",
    !is.na(CNV_sample) &  is.na(Tumor_Sample_Barcode), "CNV_file_not_in_MAF (not plotted)",
     is.na(CNV_sample) & !is.na(Tumor_Sample_Barcode), "In_MAF_no_CNV_file (CNV not assessed)"
  )]
  fwrite(cnv_sample_map, file.path(table_dir, "CNV_to_WES_sample_matching.tsv"),
         sep = "\t", quote = FALSE, na = "")
  cat("CNV sample matching:\n")
  print(cnv_sample_map[, .N, by = Status])
  if (any(cnv_sample_map$Status != "CNV_and_WES_mutations")) {
    warning("Some samples are missing CNV files or are absent from the MAF; see CNV_to_WES_sample_matching.tsv")
  }

  cnv_onecall <- merge(
    cnv_sample_gene[, .(CNV_sample, Gene_key, CNV_class)],
    cnv_sample_map[!is.na(Tumor_Sample_Barcode) & !is.na(CNV_sample),
                   .(CNV_sample, Tumor_Sample_Barcode)],
    by = "CNV_sample"
  )[, .(Tumor_Sample_Barcode, Gene_key, CNV_class)]

  cat("\nCNV calls per class (one per sample x gene, all genes):\n")
  print(cnv_onecall[, .N, by = CNV_class])

  # ------------------------------------------------------------
  # Add CNV to the gene audit and decide which genes are plotted
  # ------------------------------------------------------------
  cnv_gene_counts <- cnv_onecall[
    Gene_key %in% gene_audit$Gene_key,
    .(
      CNV_any_samples    = uniqueN(Tumor_Sample_Barcode),
      CNV_Gain_samples   = uniqueN(Tumor_Sample_Barcode[CNV_class == "Gain"]),
      CNV_Hetdel_samples = uniqueN(Tumor_Sample_Barcode[CNV_class == "Hetdel"]),
      CNV_Homdel_samples = uniqueN(Tumor_Sample_Barcode[CNV_class == "Homdel"])
    ),
    by = Gene_key
  ]
  cnv_count_cols <- setdiff(names(cnv_gene_counts), "Gene_key")
  old_cols <- intersect(c(cnv_count_cols, "Any_altered_samples"), names(gene_audit))
  if (length(old_cols) > 0) gene_audit[, (old_cols) := NULL]
  gene_audit <- merge(gene_audit, cnv_gene_counts, by = "Gene_key", all.x = TRUE, sort = FALSE)
  for (cc in cnv_count_cols) gene_audit[is.na(get(cc)), (cc) := 0L]

  # Tumors altered by mutation OR CNV (each tumor counted once per gene).
  any_pairs <- unique(rbind(
    maf_dt[Gene_key %in% gene_audit[Plotted == TRUE, Gene_key], .(Gene_key, Tumor_Sample_Barcode)],
    cnv_onecall[Gene_key %in% gene_audit$Gene_key, .(Gene_key, Tumor_Sample_Barcode)]
  ))
  any_counts <- any_pairs[, .(Any_altered_samples = .N), by = Gene_key]
  gene_audit <- merge(gene_audit, any_counts, by = "Gene_key", all.x = TRUE, sort = FALSE)
  gene_audit[is.na(Any_altered_samples), Any_altered_samples := 0L]

  gene_audit[, Plotted_mutation := Plotted]
  gene_audit[, Plotted := Plotted_mutation | CNV_any_samples >= MIN_CNV_SAMPLES]
  gene_audit[, Alteration_type := fcase(
    Plotted_mutation & CNV_any_samples >= MIN_CNV_SAMPLES, "Mutation_and_CNV",
    Plotted_mutation, "Mutation_only",
    CNV_any_samples >= MIN_CNV_SAMPLES, "CNV_only",
    default = "Not_altered"
  )]
  setorder(gene_audit, -Plotted, -Any_altered_samples, Gene)

  fwrite(gene_audit,
         file.path(table_dir, paste0("chromatin_gene_mutation_CNV_audit_", VAF_TAG, ".tsv")),
         sep = "\t", quote = FALSE, na = "")

  list_summary_cnv <- rbindlist(lapply(names(oncoplot_sets), function(nm) {
    a <- gene_audit[Gene_key %in% clean_key(oncoplot_sets[[nm]])]
    data.table(
      Gene_list = nm,
      Genes_requested = nrow(a),
      Mutation_only = sum(a$Alteration_type == "Mutation_only"),
      CNV_only = sum(a$Alteration_type == "CNV_only"),
      Mutation_and_CNV = sum(a$Alteration_type == "Mutation_and_CNV"),
      Not_altered = sum(a$Alteration_type == "Not_altered"),
      Plotted = sum(a$Plotted)
    )
  }))
  fwrite(list_summary_cnv,
         file.path(table_dir, paste0("chromatin_gene_list_mutation_CNV_summary_", VAF_TAG, ".tsv")),
         sep = "\t", quote = FALSE, na = "")
  cat("\nGenes per list (mutation and/or CNV):\n")
  print(list_summary_cnv)

  # Rows for each separate plot, per list (original list order kept).
  mut_keys      <- gene_audit[Plotted_mutation == TRUE, Gene_key]
  cnv_keys      <- gene_audit[CNV_any_samples >= MIN_CNV_SAMPLES, Gene_key]
  combined_keys <- gene_audit[Plotted == TRUE, Gene_key]

  plot_sets_mutation <- lapply(oncoplot_sets, function(g) g[clean_key(g) %in% mut_keys])
  plot_sets_cnv      <- lapply(oncoplot_sets, function(g) g[clean_key(g) %in% cnv_keys])
  plot_sets_combined <- lapply(oncoplot_sets, function(g) g[clean_key(g) %in% combined_keys])

  # plot_gene_keys is used for the variant-level table: mutation genes only.
  plot_gene_keys <- mut_keys
}
```

```{r read_pcgr}
# ============================================================
# Read PCGR xlsx files and extract ONCOGENICITY (unchanged)
# ============================================================

pcgr_files <- list.files(
  pcgr_dir,
  pattern = "\\.pcgr\\.grch38\\.xlsx$",
  recursive = TRUE,
  full.names = TRUE
)

if (length(pcgr_files) == 0) {
  pcgr_files <- list.files(
    pcgr_dir,
    pattern = "\\.xlsx$",
    recursive = TRUE,
    full.names = TRUE
  )
}

cat("PCGR xlsx files found:", length(pcgr_files), "\n\n")

pcgr_list <- list()

for (f in pcgr_files) {

  sample_name <- basename(dirname(f))

  sheets <- tryCatch(
    excel_sheets(f),
    error = function(e) character()
  )

  if (!"SOMATIC_SNV_INDEL" %in% sheets) {
    message("[SKIP] SOMATIC_SNV_INDEL sheet not found: ", f)
    next
  }

  dt <- tryCatch(
    as.data.table(read_excel(f, sheet = "SOMATIC_SNV_INDEL")),
    error = function(e) {
      message("[SKIP] Could not read: ", f)
      message("       ", e$message)
      return(NULL)
    }
  )

  if (is.null(dt) || nrow(dt) == 0) {
    next
  }

  gene_col <- find_col(
    colnames(dt),
    c("Hugo_Symbol", "HUGO_SYMBOL", "Gene", "Gene_Symbol", "SYMBOL", "GENE_NAME")
  )

  onc_col <- find_col(
    colnames(dt),
    c("ONCOGENICITY", "Oncogenicity")
  )

  if (is.na(gene_col) || is.na(onc_col)) {
    message("[SKIP] Could not find Gene or ONCOGENICITY column in: ", f)
    next
  }

  pcgr_tmp <- data.table(
    Tumor_Sample_Barcode_PCGR = sample_name,
    Sample_key = clean_sample(sample_name),
    Hugo_Symbol_PCGR = as.character(dt[[gene_col]]),
    Gene_key = clean_key(dt[[gene_col]]),
    ONCOGENICITY_RAW = as.character(dt[[onc_col]]),
    HGVSp_key = clean_hgv(get_col_or_na(dt, c("HGVSp", "HGVSP", "Protein_Change", "ProteinChange"))),
    HGVSp_Short_key = clean_hgv(get_col_or_na(dt, c("HGVSp_Short", "HGVSP_SHORT"))),
    HGVSc_key = clean_hgv(get_col_or_na(dt, c("HGVSc", "HGVSC", "Coding_Change", "CodingChange"))),
    PCGR_file = f
  )

  pcgr_tmp[, ONCOGENICITY := normalize_oncogenicity(ONCOGENICITY_RAW)]

  # Keep only Oncogenic and Likely_Oncogenic
  pcgr_tmp <- pcgr_tmp[!is.na(ONCOGENICITY)]

  if (nrow(pcgr_tmp) > 0) {
    pcgr_list[[length(pcgr_list) + 1]] <- pcgr_tmp
  }
}

if (length(pcgr_list) == 0) {
  warning("No Oncogenic/Likely_Oncogenic PCGR records found.")
  pcgr_dt <- data.table()
} else {
  pcgr_dt <- rbindlist(pcgr_list, fill = TRUE)
}

if (nrow(pcgr_dt) > 0) {
  pcgr_dt[, onc_priority := fifelse(ONCOGENICITY == "Oncogenic", 2L, 1L)]

  cat("PCGR Oncogenic/Likely_Oncogenic rows:", nrow(pcgr_dt), "\n")
  print(pcgr_dt[, .N, by = ONCOGENICITY][order(-N)])
  cat("\n")
}
```

```{r match_pcgr_to_maf}
# ============================================================
# Match PCGR oncogenicity back to MAF variant rows (unchanged)
# ============================================================

maf_annot <- maf_dt[
  ,
  .(
    maf_row_id,
    Tumor_Sample_Barcode,
    Hugo_Symbol,
    Sample_key,
    Gene_key,
    HGVSp_key,
    HGVSp_Short_key,
    HGVSc_key
  )
]

maf_annot[, ONCOGENICITY := NA_character_]
maf_annot[, oncogenicity_match_method := NA_character_]

add_pcgr_match <- function(maf_annot, pcgr_dt, keys, method_name) {

  if (nrow(pcgr_dt) == 0) {
    return(maf_annot)
  }

  pcgr_sub <- copy(pcgr_dt)

  for (k in keys) {
    pcgr_sub <- pcgr_sub[!is.na(get(k)) & get(k) != ""]
  }

  if (nrow(pcgr_sub) == 0) {
    return(maf_annot)
  }

  pcgr_best <- pcgr_sub[
    order(-onc_priority),
    .(
      ONCOGENICITY_MATCH = first(ONCOGENICITY),
      PCGR_match_priority = first(onc_priority),
      PCGR_n_matching_records = .N
    ),
    by = keys
  ]

  maf_unmatched <- maf_annot[is.na(ONCOGENICITY)]

  for (k in keys) {
    maf_unmatched <- maf_unmatched[!is.na(get(k)) & get(k) != ""]
  }

  if (nrow(maf_unmatched) == 0) {
    return(maf_annot)
  }

  tmp <- merge(
    maf_unmatched[, c("maf_row_id", keys), with = FALSE],
    pcgr_best,
    by = keys,
    all.x = FALSE,
    all.y = FALSE,
    allow.cartesian = TRUE
  )

  if (nrow(tmp) == 0) {
    return(maf_annot)
  }

  tmp <- tmp[
    order(-PCGR_match_priority),
    .SD[1],
    by = maf_row_id
  ]

  maf_annot[
    tmp,
    on = "maf_row_id",
    `:=`(
      ONCOGENICITY = i.ONCOGENICITY_MATCH,
      oncogenicity_match_method = method_name
    )
  ]

  return(maf_annot)
}

if (nrow(pcgr_dt) > 0) {

  maf_annot <- add_pcgr_match(
    maf_annot, pcgr_dt,
    keys = c("Sample_key", "Gene_key", "HGVSp_key"),
    method_name = "Sample+Gene+HGVSp"
  )

  maf_annot <- add_pcgr_match(
    maf_annot, pcgr_dt,
    keys = c("Sample_key", "Gene_key", "HGVSp_Short_key"),
    method_name = "Sample+Gene+HGVSp_Short"
  )

  maf_annot <- add_pcgr_match(
    maf_annot, pcgr_dt,
    keys = c("Sample_key", "Gene_key", "HGVSc_key"),
    method_name = "Sample+Gene+HGVSc"
  )

  if (allow_sample_gene_fallback) {
    maf_annot <- add_pcgr_match(
      maf_annot, pcgr_dt,
      keys = c("Sample_key", "Gene_key"),
      method_name = "Sample+Gene_fallback"
    )
  }
}

maf_dt <- merge(
  maf_dt,
  maf_annot[, .(maf_row_id, ONCOGENICITY, oncogenicity_match_method)],
  by = "maf_row_id",
  all.x = TRUE
)

cat("MAF rows matched to PCGR Oncogenic/Likely_Oncogenic:\n")
print(
  maf_dt[
    !is.na(ONCOGENICITY),
    .N,
    by = .(ONCOGENICITY, oncogenicity_match_method)
  ][order(ONCOGENICITY, oncogenicity_match_method)]
)
cat("\n")

fwrite(
  maf_dt[
    Gene_key %in% plot_gene_keys,
    .(
      Tumor_Sample_Barcode,
      Hugo_Symbol,
      Variant_Classification,
      VAF_percent,
      HGVSp,
      HGVSp_Short,
      HGVSc,
      ONCOGENICITY,
      oncogenicity_match_method
    )
  ],
  file = file.path(table_dir, paste0("chromatin_variant_level_pcgr_match_", VAF_TAG, ".tsv")),
  sep = "\t",
  quote = FALSE,
  na = ""
)
```

```{r define_plot_function}
# ============================================================
# Main plotting function
# Based on the functional-category oncoplot function. When INCLUDE_CNV = TRUE:
#   - each cell: CNV = full-cell color, mutation = smaller inner box
#   - rows: genes with a qualifying mutation OR a CNV
#   - row order: tumors altered by mutation or CNV (high to low)
#   - extra top barplot (CNV genes per sample) and right barplot (CNV class)
# When INCLUDE_CNV = FALSE the plot matches the original mutation-only style.
# ============================================================

# sample_order: column order; sample_group: RNA cluster per column (same order),
# or NULL for the original TP-order style without a cluster bar.
# layers: "mutation", "cnv", or c("mutation", "cnv") for the merged plot.
make_category_oncoplot <- function(category_name, genes,
                                   sample_order = all_samples,
                                   sample_group = NULL,
                                   layers = "mutation") {

  show_mut <- "mutation" %in% layers
  show_cnv <- "cnv" %in% layers && isTRUE(INCLUDE_CNV)
  both_layers <- show_mut && show_cnv
  layer_label <- if (both_layers) "mutation + CNV" else if (show_cnv) "CNV" else "mutations"

  cat("============================================================\n")
  cat("Category:", category_name, "\n")
  cat("============================================================\n")

  genes <- unique(genes)
  genes_key <- clean_key(genes)
  gene_label <- setNames(genes, genes_key)   # key -> display name

  # Column order supplied by the caller (RNA-cluster order or TP order)
  plot_samples <- sample_order

  cat_maf <- if (show_mut) {
    maf_dt[Gene_key %in% genes_key & Tumor_Sample_Barcode %in% plot_samples]
  } else {
    maf_dt[0]
  }
  cat_cnv <- if (show_cnv) {
    cnv_onecall[Gene_key %in% genes_key & Tumor_Sample_Barcode %in% plot_samples]
  } else {
    cnv_onecall[0]
  }

  if (nrow(cat_maf) == 0 && nrow(cat_cnv) == 0) {
    cat("No altered genes from this list. Skipping.\n\n")
    return(NULL)
  }

  # ------------------------------------------------------------
  # Mutation cell-level summary
  # Multi_Hit = >1 MAF variant row in same Sample + Gene
  # Oncogenicity priority = Oncogenic > Likely_Oncogenic
  # ------------------------------------------------------------

  if (nrow(cat_maf) > 0) {
    cell_dt <- cat_maf[
      ,
      {
        onc_vals <- ONCOGENICITY[!is.na(ONCOGENICITY)]

        cell_onc <- ""

        if ("Oncogenic" %in% onc_vals) {
          cell_onc <- "Oncogenic"
        } else if ("Likely_Oncogenic" %in% onc_vals) {
          cell_onc <- "Likely_Oncogenic"
        }

        list(
          n_variants = .N,
          Display = ifelse(.N > 1, "Multi_Hit", as.character(Variant_Classification[1])),
          Variant_Classification_List = paste(unique(Variant_Classification), collapse = ";"),
          HGVSp_List = paste(unique(na.omit(HGVSp)), collapse = ";"),
          HGVSc_List = paste(unique(na.omit(HGVSc)), collapse = ";"),
          VAF_percent_List = paste(unique(na.omit(VAF_percent)), collapse = ";"),
          Cell_ONCOGENICITY = cell_onc,
          ONCOGENICITY_List = paste(unique(na.omit(ONCOGENICITY)), collapse = ";"),
          ONCOGENICITY_match_methods = paste(unique(na.omit(oncogenicity_match_method)), collapse = ";")
        )
      },
      by = .(Tumor_Sample_Barcode, Gene_key)
    ]
  } else {
    cell_dt <- data.table(
      Tumor_Sample_Barcode = character(), Gene_key = character(),
      n_variants = integer(), Display = character(), Cell_ONCOGENICITY = character()
    )
  }
  cell_dt[, Gene := unname(gene_label[Gene_key])]
  cat_cnv <- copy(cat_cnv)
  cat_cnv[, Gene := unname(gene_label[Gene_key])]

  # ------------------------------------------------------------
  # Order genes: tumors altered by mutation OR CNV (high to low)
  # Tie-breakers: mutated tumors, variant rows, original list order
  # ------------------------------------------------------------

  altered_pairs <- unique(rbind(
    cell_dt[, .(Gene_key, Tumor_Sample_Barcode)],
    cat_cnv[, .(Gene_key, Tumor_Sample_Barcode)]
  ))
  gene_order_dt <- altered_pairs[, .(n_altered_samples = .N), by = Gene_key]
  mut_counts <- cell_dt[, .(n_mutated_samples = .N, n_variant_rows = sum(n_variants)), by = Gene_key]
  gene_order_dt <- merge(gene_order_dt, mut_counts, by = "Gene_key", all.x = TRUE)
  gene_order_dt[is.na(n_mutated_samples), `:=`(n_mutated_samples = 0L, n_variant_rows = 0L)]
  gene_order_dt[, category_order := match(Gene_key, genes_key)]
  gene_order_dt[, Gene := unname(gene_label[Gene_key])]

  setorder(
    gene_order_dt,
    -n_altered_samples,
    -n_mutated_samples,
    -n_variant_rows,
    category_order,
    Gene
  )

  plot_genes <- gene_order_dt$Gene

  layer_suffix <- if (both_layers) "_mutation_CNV" else if (show_cnv) "_CNV" else "_mutation"
  category_safe <- paste0(safe_file_name(category_name), layer_suffix)

  # Cell-level table: mutation and CNV per sample x gene
  cell_table <- merge(
    cell_dt,
    cat_cnv[, .(Tumor_Sample_Barcode, Gene_key, CNV_class)],
    by = c("Tumor_Sample_Barcode", "Gene_key"),
    all = TRUE
  )
  cell_table[, Gene := unname(gene_label[Gene_key])]

  fwrite(
    cell_table,
    file = file.path(table_dir, paste0(category_safe, "_cell_level_oncoplot_table.tsv")),
    sep = "\t",
    quote = FALSE,
    na = ""
  )

  # ------------------------------------------------------------
  # Mutation matrix, oncogenicity matrix and CNV matrix
  # ------------------------------------------------------------

  empty_mat <- function() {
    matrix("", nrow = length(plot_genes), ncol = length(plot_samples),
           dimnames = list(plot_genes, plot_samples))
  }
  mut_mat <- empty_mat()
  onc_mat <- empty_mat()
  cnv_mat <- empty_mat()

  for (ii in seq_len(nrow(cell_dt))) {
    g <- cell_dt$Gene[ii]
    s <- cell_dt$Tumor_Sample_Barcode[ii]
    if (g %in% rownames(mut_mat) && s %in% colnames(mut_mat)) {
      mut_mat[g, s] <- cell_dt$Display[ii]
      onc_mat[g, s] <- cell_dt$Cell_ONCOGENICITY[ii]
    }
  }

  for (ii in seq_len(nrow(cat_cnv))) {
    g <- cat_cnv$Gene[ii]
    s <- cat_cnv$Tumor_Sample_Barcode[ii]
    if (g %in% rownames(cnv_mat) && s %in% colnames(cnv_mat)) {
      cnv_mat[g, s] <- cat_cnv$CNV_class[ii]
    }
  }

  # Helper: long counts -> matrix in a fixed row order (missing = 0)
  counts_to_matrix <- function(dt, row_col, class_col, row_ids, classes = NULL) {
    if (nrow(dt) == 0) {
      cls <- if (is.null(classes)) "None" else classes
      return(matrix(0, nrow = length(row_ids), ncol = length(cls),
                    dimnames = list(row_ids, cls)))
    }
    wide <- dcast(dt, as.formula(paste(row_col, "~", class_col)), value.var = "N", fill = 0)
    wide <- merge(setnames(data.table(row_ids), row_col), wide, by = row_col,
                  all.x = TRUE, sort = FALSE)
    wide <- wide[match(row_ids, wide[[row_col]])]
    cls <- setdiff(names(wide), row_col)
    if (!is.null(classes)) {
      for (cc in setdiff(classes, cls)) wide[, (cc) := 0]
      cls <- classes
    }
    m <- as.matrix(wide[, ..cls])
    m[is.na(m)] <- 0
    rownames(m) <- row_ids
    m
  }

  # Guard: anno_barplot needs a non-zero axis range
  safe_ylim <- function(m) c(0, max(1, max(rowSums(m))))

  # ------------------------------------------------------------
  # Top barplots: mutations per sample and CNV genes per sample
  # ------------------------------------------------------------

  sample_class_mat <- counts_to_matrix(
    cat_maf[, .N, by = .(Tumor_Sample_Barcode, Variant_Classification)],
    "Tumor_Sample_Barcode", "Variant_Classification", plot_samples
  )

  cnv_classes <- names(cnv_cols)
  sample_cnv_mat <- counts_to_matrix(
    cat_cnv[, .N, by = .(Tumor_Sample_Barcode, CNV_class)],
    "Tumor_Sample_Barcode", "CNV_class", plot_samples, classes = cnv_classes
  )

  # ------------------------------------------------------------
  # Right barplots: mutated tumors by class, CNV tumors by class
  # ------------------------------------------------------------

  gene_class_mat <- counts_to_matrix(
    cell_dt[, .N, by = .(Gene, Display)], "Gene", "Display", plot_genes
  )
  gene_cnv_mat <- counts_to_matrix(
    cat_cnv[, .N, by = .(Gene, CNV_class)], "Gene", "CNV_class", plot_genes,
    classes = cnv_classes
  )

  # % altered = tumors with a mutation OR a CNV in the gene
  gene_altered_counts <- rowSums(mut_mat != "" | cnv_mat != "")
  gene_altered_pct <- round(100 * gene_altered_counts / ncol(mut_mat))

  # ------------------------------------------------------------
  # Bottom clinical annotations (unchanged)
  # ------------------------------------------------------------

  plot_sample_keys <- clean_sample(plot_samples)

  sample_clin_dt <- data.table(
    Tumor_Sample_Barcode = plot_samples,
    Sample_key = plot_sample_keys
  )

  sample_clin_dt <- merge(
    sample_clin_dt,
    clinical_plot_dt,
    by = "Sample_key",
    all.x = TRUE,
    sort = FALSE
  )

  sample_clin_dt <- sample_clin_dt[
    match(plot_samples, Tumor_Sample_Barcode)
  ]

  sample_clin_dt[, Column_Index := seq_len(.N)]
  if (!is.null(sample_group)) sample_clin_dt[, RNA_cluster := sample_group]

  setcolorder(
    sample_clin_dt,
    c(
      "Column_Index",
      "Tumor_Sample_Barcode",
      "Sample_key",
      setdiff(
        colnames(sample_clin_dt),
        c("Column_Index", "Tumor_Sample_Barcode", "Sample_key")
      )
    )
  )

  fwrite(
    sample_clin_dt,
    file = file.path(table_dir, paste0(category_safe, "_sample_order_and_clinical_annotation.tsv")),
    sep = "\t",
    quote = FALSE,
    na = ""
  )

  clinical_anno_df <- data.frame(
    `Tumor cell. (%)` = sample_clin_dt$tumor_cellularity_pct,
    `Pleomorphic (%)` = sample_clin_dt$pleomorphic_component_cellularity_pct,
    `TILs (%)` = sample_clin_dt$TILs_pct,
    Grade = sample_clin_dt$Grade_clean,
    HER2 = sample_clin_dt$HER2_status,
    ER = sample_clin_dt$ER_status,
    PR = sample_clin_dt$PR_status,
    check.names = FALSE
  )

  rownames(clinical_anno_df) <- plot_samples

  observed_grade_levels <- unique(na.omit(clinical_anno_df$Grade))
  observed_grade_levels <- observed_grade_levels[observed_grade_levels != ""]

  missing_grade_levels <- setdiff(observed_grade_levels, names(grade_cols))

  grade_cols_local <- grade_cols

  if (length(missing_grade_levels) > 0) {
    extra_grade_cols <- hcl.colors(length(missing_grade_levels), palette = "Dark 3")
    names(extra_grade_cols) <- missing_grade_levels
    grade_cols_local <- c(grade_cols_local, extra_grade_cols)
  }

  clinical_anno_cols <- list(
    `Tumor cell. (%)` = colorRamp2(
      c(0, 50, 100),
      c("#F7FBFF", "#6BAED6", "#08306B")
    ),
    `Pleomorphic (%)` = colorRamp2(
      c(0, 50, 100),
      c("#F7FCF5", "#74C476", "#00441B")
    ),
    `TILs (%)` = colorRamp2(
      c(0, 30, 100),
      c("#FFF5F0", "#FB6A4A", "#67000D")
    ),
    Grade = grade_cols_local,
    HER2 = binary_receptor_cols,
    ER = binary_receptor_cols,
    PR = binary_receptor_cols
  )

  bottom_clin_ha <- HeatmapAnnotation(
    ` ` = anno_empty(
      height = unit(1, "mm"),
      border = FALSE
    ),
    df = clinical_anno_df,
    col = clinical_anno_cols,
    na_col = "grey90",
    which = "column",
    annotation_name_side = "left",
    annotation_name_rot = 0,
    annotation_name_gp = gpar(fontsize = 8),
    simple_anno_size = unit(0.30, "cm"),
    gap = unit(c(3.5, rep(1.1, ncol(clinical_anno_df) - 1)), "mm"),
    show_annotation_name = c(
      ` ` = FALSE,
      `Tumor cell. (%)` = TRUE,
      `Pleomorphic (%)` = TRUE,
      `TILs (%)` = TRUE,
      Grade = TRUE,
      HER2 = TRUE,
      ER = TRUE,
      PR = TRUE
    ),
    annotation_legend_param = list(
      `Tumor cell. (%)` = list(title = "Tumor cell. (%)"),
      `Pleomorphic (%)` = list(title = "Pleomorphic (%)"),
      `TILs (%)` = list(title = "TILs (%)"),
      Grade = list(title = "Grade"),
      HER2 = list(title = "HER2"),
      ER = list(title = "ER"),
      PR = list(title = "PR")
    )
  )

  # ------------------------------------------------------------
  # Mutation colors
  # ------------------------------------------------------------

  all_mutation_types_for_plot <- sort(unique(c(
    as.vector(mut_mat[mut_mat != ""]),
    colnames(sample_class_mat),
    colnames(gene_class_mat)
  )))
  all_mutation_types_for_plot <- setdiff(all_mutation_types_for_plot, c("None", ""))

  mutation_colors <- get_mutation_colors(all_mutation_types_for_plot)

  sample_bar_colors <- mutation_colors[colnames(sample_class_mat)]
  sample_bar_colors[is.na(sample_bar_colors)] <- "grey50"

  row_bar_colors <- mutation_colors[colnames(gene_class_mat)]
  row_bar_colors[is.na(row_bar_colors)] <- "grey50"

  # ------------------------------------------------------------
  # Top annotation: mutation barplot, CNV barplot, RNA cluster bar
  # ------------------------------------------------------------

  top_args <- list()
  if (show_mut) top_args[["Mutations per sample"]] <- anno_barplot(
      sample_class_mat,
      gp = gpar(fill = sample_bar_colors, col = NA),
      border = FALSE,
      bar_width = 0.97,
      ylim = safe_ylim(sample_class_mat),
      height = unit(2.2, "cm"),
      axis_param = list(gp = gpar(fontsize = 8))
    )

  if (show_cnv) {
    top_args[["CNV genes per sample"]] <- anno_barplot(
      sample_cnv_mat,
      gp = gpar(fill = cnv_cols[colnames(sample_cnv_mat)], col = NA),
      border = FALSE,
      bar_width = 0.97,
      ylim = safe_ylim(sample_cnv_mat),
      height = unit(if (both_layers) 1.8 else 2.2, "cm"),
      axis_param = list(gp = gpar(fontsize = 8))
    )
  }

  top_extra <- list(
    annotation_name_gp = gpar(fontsize = 9),
    gap = unit(1.5, "mm")
  )

  if (is.null(sample_group)) {
    column_split_vec <- NULL
    column_gap_unit <- unit(0.05, "mm")
  } else {
    present_groups <- intersect(names(rna_cluster_colors), unique(sample_group))
    top_args[["RNA cluster"]] <- sample_group
    top_extra$col <- list(`RNA cluster` = rna_cluster_colors[present_groups])
    top_extra$simple_anno_size <- unit(4, "mm")
    top_extra$annotation_legend_param <- list(`RNA cluster` = list(title = "RNA cluster"))
    column_split_vec <- factor(sample_group, levels = present_groups)
    column_gap_unit <- unit(1.5, "mm")
  }

  top_bar_ha <- do.call(HeatmapAnnotation, c(top_args, top_extra))

  # ------------------------------------------------------------
  # Right annotation: class barplots and % altered
  # ------------------------------------------------------------

  # NOTE: which = "row" is required because these annotation functions are
  # created outside rowAnnotation(); without it ComplexHeatmap treats them as
  # column annotations and the plot fails.
  mut_bar <- anno_barplot(
    gene_class_mat,
    which = "row",
    gp = gpar(fill = row_bar_colors, col = NA),
    border = FALSE,
    bar_width = 0.90,
    ylim = safe_ylim(gene_class_mat),
    axis = TRUE,
    axis_param = list(gp = gpar(fontsize = 7), side = "bottom"),
    width = unit(2.6, "cm")
  )

  pct_text <- anno_text(
    paste0(gene_altered_pct, "%"),
    which = "row",
    gp = gpar(fontsize = 10),
    just = "left",
    location = 0
  )

  cnv_bar <- anno_barplot(
    gene_cnv_mat,
    which = "row",
    gp = gpar(fill = cnv_cols[colnames(gene_cnv_mat)], col = NA),
    border = FALSE,
    bar_width = 0.90,
    ylim = safe_ylim(gene_cnv_mat),
    axis = TRUE,
    axis_param = list(gp = gpar(fontsize = 7), side = "bottom"),
    width = unit(2.6, "cm")
  )

  if (both_layers) {
    right_bar_ha <- rowAnnotation(
      `Mutated` = mut_bar,
      `CNV` = cnv_bar,
      `% altered` = pct_text,
      gap = unit(2, "mm"),
      show_annotation_name = c(TRUE, TRUE, FALSE),
      annotation_name_side = "bottom",
      annotation_name_rot = 0,
      annotation_name_gp = gpar(fontsize = 8)
    )
  } else if (show_cnv) {
    right_bar_ha <- rowAnnotation(
      `CNV samples by class` = cnv_bar,
      `% altered` = pct_text,
      gap = unit(2, "mm"),
      show_annotation_name = FALSE
    )
  } else {
    right_bar_ha <- rowAnnotation(
      `Altered samples by class` = mut_bar,
      `% altered` = pct_text,
      show_annotation_name = FALSE
    )
  }

  # ------------------------------------------------------------
  # Cell size: 4 mm squares; rows shrink if there are many genes
  # so the figure stays within a printable height
  # ------------------------------------------------------------

  cell_w_mm <- 4.0
  max_body_height_mm <- 22 * 25.4
  cell_h_mm <- min(4.0, max_body_height_mm / max(1, nrow(mut_mat)))

  heatmap_body_width_mm <- max(55, cell_w_mm * ncol(mut_mat))
  heatmap_body_height_mm <- max(38, cell_h_mm * nrow(mut_mat))

  row_font <- if (cell_h_mm >= 4) 10 else max(5, round(10 * cell_h_mm / 4, 1))
  symbol_mm <- min(1.8, 0.45 * cell_h_mm)

  extra_w_in <- if (both_layers) 12 else 9.5
  extra_h_in <- if (both_layers) 7 else 5.5
  plot_width <- max(13, min(30, heatmap_body_width_mm / 25.4 + extra_w_in))
  plot_height <- max(8, min(32, heatmap_body_height_mm / 25.4 + extra_h_in))

  # ------------------------------------------------------------
  # Legends (built explicitly so CNV-only lists also work)
  # ------------------------------------------------------------

  lgd_list <- list()

  if (show_mut && length(mutation_colors) > 0) {
    lgd_list[[length(lgd_list) + 1]] <- Legend(
      title = if (both_layers) "Mutation (inner box)" else "Mutation type",
      labels = names(mutation_colors),
      legend_gp = gpar(fill = unname(mutation_colors)),
      title_gp = gpar(fontsize = 9, fontface = "bold"),
      labels_gp = gpar(fontsize = 8)
    )
  }

  if (show_cnv) {
    lgd_list[[length(lgd_list) + 1]] <- Legend(
      title = if (both_layers) "CNV (full cell)" else "CNV class",
      labels = names(cnv_cols),
      legend_gp = gpar(fill = unname(cnv_cols)),
      title_gp = gpar(fontsize = 9, fontface = "bold"),
      labels_gp = gpar(fontsize = 8)
    )
  }

  if (show_mut) lgd_list[[length(lgd_list) + 1]] <- Legend(
    title = "PCGR oncogenicity",
    type = "points",
    labels = c("Oncogenic", "Likely_Oncogenic"),
    pch = c(8, 24),
    size = unit(c(2.0, 2.0), "mm"),
    legend_gp = gpar(col = "black", fill = "black")
  )

  # ------------------------------------------------------------
  # Oncoplot. The heatmap body is a placeholder; every cell is
  # drawn in layer_fun (grey background, CNV fill, mutation box, symbol).
  # ------------------------------------------------------------

  placeholder_mat <- matrix(
    0, nrow = length(plot_genes), ncol = length(plot_samples),
    dimnames = list(plot_genes, plot_samples)
  )

  mut_box_frac <- if (both_layers) mut_inner_frac else 0.96
  mut_box_border <- if (both_layers) "white" else NA

  ht <- Heatmap(
    placeholder_mat,
    name = "Alterations",
    col = colorRamp2(c(0, 1), c("grey80", "grey80")),
    show_heatmap_legend = FALSE,
    cluster_rows = FALSE,
    cluster_columns = FALSE,
    row_order = plot_genes,
    column_order = plot_samples,
    column_split = column_split_vec,
    show_row_names = TRUE,
    show_column_names = FALSE,
    row_names_side = "left",
    row_names_gp = gpar(fontsize = row_font),
    column_title = paste0(
      category_name, " (", layer_label, ")",
      " | genes: ", nrow(mut_mat),
      " | samples: ", ncol(mut_mat)
    ),
    column_title_gp = gpar(fontsize = 11, fontface = "bold"),
    width = unit(heatmap_body_width_mm, "mm"),
    height = unit(heatmap_body_height_mm, "mm"),
    rect_gp = gpar(type = "none"),
    top_annotation = top_bar_ha,
    bottom_annotation = bottom_clin_ha,
    right_annotation = right_bar_ha,
    column_gap = column_gap_unit,
    row_gap = unit(0.05, "mm"),
    layer_fun = function(j, i, x, y, width, height, fill) {

      # 1. grey background for every cell
      grid.rect(
        x = x,
        y = y,
        width = width * 0.995,
        height = height * 0.995,
        gp = gpar(fill = "grey80", col = "white", lwd = 0.10)
      )

      for (kk in seq_along(x)) {

        # 2. CNV: full-cell color
        this_cnv <- cnv_mat[i[kk], j[kk]]
        if (this_cnv != "") {
          grid.rect(
            x = x[kk], y = y[kk],
            width = width[kk] * 0.96, height = height[kk] * 0.96,
            gp = gpar(fill = cnv_cols[this_cnv], col = NA)
          )
        }

        # 3. Mutation: inner box (full cell when CNV is not shown)
        this_mut <- mut_mat[i[kk], j[kk]]
        if (this_mut != "") {
          grid.rect(
            x = x[kk], y = y[kk],
            width = width[kk] * mut_box_frac, height = height[kk] * mut_box_frac,
            gp = gpar(fill = mutation_colors[this_mut], col = mut_box_border, lwd = 0.6)
          )
        }

        # 4. PCGR oncogenicity symbol on mutated cells
        this_onc <- onc_mat[i[kk], j[kk]]
        symbol_col <- if (this_mut == "Multi_Hit") "white" else "black"

        if (this_onc == "Oncogenic") {
          grid.points(
            x = x[kk], y = y[kk], pch = 8, size = unit(symbol_mm, "mm"),
            gp = gpar(col = symbol_col, fill = symbol_col, lwd = 1.0)
          )
        } else if (this_onc == "Likely_Oncogenic") {
          grid.points(
            x = x[kk], y = y[kk], pch = 24, size = unit(symbol_mm, "mm"),
            gp = gpar(col = symbol_col, fill = symbol_col, lwd = 1.0)
          )
        }
      }
    }
  )

  # ------------------------------------------------------------
  # Save PDF and PNG
  # ------------------------------------------------------------

  # e.g. Curated_chromatin_all_genes_CNV_oncoplot.pdf
  #      Curated_chromatin_all_genes_mutation_oncoplot_VAFge5pct.pdf
  file_stem <- if (show_cnv && !show_mut) {
    paste0(category_safe, "_oncoplot")                 # CNV has no VAF filter
  } else {
    paste0(category_safe, "_oncoplot_", VAF_TAG)
  }
  pdf_file <- file.path(out_dir, paste0(file_stem, ".pdf"))
  png_file <- file.path(out_dir, paste0(file_stem, ".png"))

  draw_oncoplot <- function() {
    draw(
      ht,
      heatmap_legend_side = "right",
      annotation_legend_side = "right",
      heatmap_legend_list = lgd_list,
      merge_legends = FALSE,
      padding = unit(c(4, 28, 6, 4), "mm")
    )
  }

  pdf(pdf_file, width = plot_width, height = plot_height)
  draw_oncoplot()
  dev.off()

  if (isTRUE(SAVE_PNG)) {
    png(filename = png_file, width = plot_width, height = plot_height, units = "in", res = 300)
    draw_oncoplot()
    dev.off()
  } else {
    png_file <- NA_character_
  }

  cat("Saved:\n")
  cat("  ", pdf_file, "\n")
  if (!is.na(png_file)) cat("  ", png_file, "\n")
  cat("\n")

  summary_dt <- data.table(
    Category = category_name,
    Layers = layer_label,
    Genes_requested = length(genes),
    Genes_plotted = nrow(mut_mat),
    Genes_with_mutation = sum(rowSums(mut_mat != "") > 0),
    Genes_with_CNV = sum(rowSums(cnv_mat != "") > 0),
    Samples_shown = ncol(mut_mat),
    Sample_order = ifelse(is.null(sample_group), "TP order", "RNA cluster, then TP order"),
    Cells_with_mutation = sum(mut_mat != ""),
    Cells_with_CNV = sum(cnv_mat != ""),
    Cells_with_mutation_and_CNV = sum(mut_mat != "" & cnv_mat != ""),
    Cells_with_Oncogenic_symbol = sum(onc_mat == "Oncogenic"),
    Cells_with_Likely_Oncogenic_symbol = sum(onc_mat == "Likely_Oncogenic"),
    Row_height_mm = round(cell_h_mm, 2),
    PDF = pdf_file,
    PNG = png_file,
    Sample_order_TSV = file.path(
      table_dir,
      paste0(category_safe, "_sample_order_and_clinical_annotation.tsv")
    ),
    Cell_level_TSV = file.path(
      table_dir,
      paste0(category_safe, "_cell_level_oncoplot_table.tsv")
    )
  )

  graphics.off()
  gc()

  return(summary_dt)
}
```


```{r run_oncoplots}
# ============================================================
# Generate one oncoplot per gene list
# ============================================================

graphics.off()
gc()

oncoplot_summaries <- list()

# One job per (gene list x plot type). Mutation and CNV are separate figures.
plot_jobs <- list()
if (isTRUE(PLOT_MUTATION)) {
  for (nm in names(plot_sets_mutation)) {
    plot_jobs[[length(plot_jobs) + 1]] <- list(list_name = nm, layers = "mutation",
                                               genes = plot_sets_mutation[[nm]])
  }
}
if (isTRUE(PLOT_CNV) && isTRUE(INCLUDE_CNV)) {
  for (nm in names(plot_sets_cnv)) {
    plot_jobs[[length(plot_jobs) + 1]] <- list(list_name = nm, layers = "cnv",
                                               genes = plot_sets_cnv[[nm]])
  }
}
if (isTRUE(PLOT_COMBINED) && isTRUE(INCLUDE_CNV)) {
  for (nm in names(plot_sets_combined)) {
    plot_jobs[[length(plot_jobs) + 1]] <- list(list_name = nm, layers = c("mutation", "cnv"),
                                               genes = plot_sets_combined[[nm]])
  }
}

for (job in plot_jobs) {

  cat("\n\n############################################################\n")
  cat("Running:", job$list_name, "|", paste(job$layers, collapse = " + "), "\n")
  cat("############################################################\n\n")

  if (length(job$genes) == 0) {
    cat("No altered genes in this list for this plot type. Skipping.\n")
    next
  }

  res <- tryCatch(
    make_category_oncoplot(
      category_name = job$list_name,
      genes = job$genes,
      sample_order = plot_sample_order,   # same column order for every oncoplot
      sample_group = plot_sample_group,
      layers = job$layers
    ),
    error = function(e) {
      message("[ERROR] Failed: ", job$list_name, " | ", paste(job$layers, collapse = " + "))
      message("Reason: ", e$message)
      return(NULL)
    }
  )

  if (!is.null(res)) {
    res[, Genes_in_list := length(oncoplot_sets[[job$list_name]])]
    oncoplot_summaries[[length(oncoplot_summaries) + 1]] <- res
  }

  graphics.off()
  gc()
}

cat("\nPlots made:", length(oncoplot_summaries), "of", length(plot_jobs), "\n")
if (length(oncoplot_summaries) < length(plot_jobs)) {
  warning("Some plots failed; search the output above for [ERROR].")
}

if (length(oncoplot_summaries) > 0) {
  oncoplot_summary_dt <- rbindlist(oncoplot_summaries, fill = TRUE)
  oncoplot_summary_dt[, `:=`(
    MAF_VAF_filter = VAF_LABEL,
    VAF_source = "PCGR VAF_TUMOR via upstream match audit",
    VAF_audit_table = vaf_audit_file,
    Leading_edge_table = leading_edge_file,
    MAF = maf_file,
    Frequency_table = gene_freq_file
  )]

  fwrite(
    oncoplot_summary_dt,
    file.path(table_dir, paste0("chromatin_oncoplot_summary_", VAF_TAG, ".tsv")),
    sep = "\t", quote = FALSE, na = ""
  )
  print(oncoplot_summary_dt[, .(Category, Layers, Genes_in_list, Genes_plotted, Genes_with_mutation, Genes_with_CNV)])
}

writeLines(
  capture.output(sessionInfo()),
  file.path(out_dir, paste0("sessionInfo_chromatin_oncoplots_", VAF_TAG, ".txt"))
)

cat("\nAll done.\n")
cat("Plots saved in:\n", out_dir, "\n")
cat("Tables saved in:\n", table_dir, "\n")
```
